prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1301; do not mention it.)
text:
This clinical treatment summary is provided for a patient who sustained a shoulder injury following a sideswipe collision while changing lanes. The patient presented with pain and restricted range of motion in the affected shoulder and was evaluated with a thorough orthopedic examination. Imaging was reviewed and findings were consistent with soft tissue injury to the rotator cuff musculature, without evidence of fracture or dislocation.

Conservative management was initiated, consisting of a structured physical therapy program focused on restoring range of motion, progressive strengthening of the rotator cuff and periscapular muscles, and posture and body mechanics education. Anti-inflammatory medication was prescribed for pain control, and activity modifications were recommended during the acute phase of recovery.

The patient completed 12 supervised therapy visits over the course of treatment. Progress was steady, with gradual improvement in pain levels, strength, and functional use of the arm for daily activities. At the most recent visit, the patient demonstrated near-full range of motion with residual mild weakness on resisted testing. A home exercise program was issued, and the patient was advised to follow up if symptoms worsen or fail to continue improving.
